sub: Recreation of @krunch.7 (555.8K views) with Grace's body, both colours, sequin Vans. Plan round 1, 2026-10-25.

ask.title: Plan ready: 6 questions, then one OK
ask.text:
1. Grace's height, size and which length she got (Regular or Longer)? S3 says them out loud (the top buyer question).
2. Grace's voice (script below) or music only?
3. Shoes = the sequin checkerboard Vans from the Vans videos (your "vans crocs shiny ones")?
4. Black + white crop tank in the sage kitchen, brown + cream puff-sleeve crop top in the grey-stool kitchen: OK?
5. Stills on Kie ($0.72) or your Gemini app ($0)?
6. No on-screen text (default)?
TOTAL $4.275 cap, expected $0.72. First paid step: only the S3 and S4 stills ($0.18), then your 2 Flow takes, before anything else.

I've got them in black, and in brown too, because when I find something I like, I get more than one. Black and brown go with everything for fall, so grab both. I linked them in the orange cart for you.
